newsitem.title: THAILAND: Hoare Govett seeks 49 pct stake in Asia Securities.
newsitem.headline: Hoare Govett seeks 49 pct stake in Asia Securities.

text.p: Asia Securities Trading Plc said on Wednesday ABN Amro Hoare Govett has expressed a plan to tender for 49 percent of its equity.
Asia Securities said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand that Hoare Govett is seeking to buy 63 million of its outstanding issued shares at 35 baht each.
The bourse suspended trading in Asia Securities on Wednesday pending further details of Hoare Govett's plan.
Asian Securities closed at 24.00 baht on Tuesday.
Hoare Govett is scheduled to brief the media later on Wednesday on its planned tender offer.
Thailand's largest commercial bank Bangkok Bank Plc is a major shareholder in Asia Securities.
